findings.issue: Fallback polling can hide the actual malformed-tree diagnostic.
findings.disposition: Fixed. The error banner shows the diagnostic and a valid poll clears it.

findings.issue: Malformed SSE trace warnings can be masked by source diagnostics or survive a valid replacement.
findings.disposition: Fixed. Scoped payload warnings coexist with source diagnostics and clear on matching recovery.

findings.issue: The preset anchor can silently accept an invalid offset or lose fractional seconds.
findings.disposition: Fixed. The UTC parser rejects invalid offsets and preserves milliseconds.

findings.issue: Malformed negative or unsafe token counters can replace accepted trace data.
findings.disposition: Fixed. Both live trace transports require nonnegative safe integer counts.

findings.issue: The Progression suite did not detect loss of incomplete-ledger anchor fallback.
findings.disposition: Fixed. Start, update and no-anchor cases now protect the fallback.

findings.issue: The dashboard suite did not exercise deferred settlement after unmount.
findings.disposition: Fixed. Both hook settlement tests detect removed generation cleanup.

findings.issue: An older REST trace can erase a newer same-session SSE validation warning.
findings.disposition: Fixed. Identified malformed pushes retire older selected REST reads.

findings.issue: A valid trace can erase another session's still-unresolved validation warning.
findings.disposition: Fixed. Warnings are keyed by bounded session ownership and clear independently.
